description: Use CLOCK_REALTIME in coax/web/api/sign.c and retry stale created_at in API tests (test_access.py, test_private.py).

steps.send: In `coax/web/api/sign.c`, `coax/web/api/test_access.py`, and `coax/web/api/test_private.py` (#13800): 1) Switch timestamp generation in `coax/web/api/sign.c` to `CLOCK_REALTIME` (`clock_gettime(CLOCK_REALTIME, ...)`). 2) In `test_access.py` and `test_private.py`, wait/retry until the signed NIP-98 `created_at` strictly advances past `prev` so rapid requests never collide on the same second. Verify with `python3 -m py_compile coax/web/api/test_access.py coax/web/api/test_private.py`.

graders.run: grep -q 'CLOCK_REALTIME' coax/web/api/sign.c && grep -q 'created_at' coax/web/api/test_access.py && grep -q 'created_at' coax/web/api/test_private.py && python3 -m py_compile coax/web/api/test_access.py coax/web/api/test_private.py
